name: Recovery spin
purpose: Restore movement without adding meaningful stress
notes: Keep cadence comfortable; skip if rest is more appropriate.

name: Endurance 60
notes: Steady, conversational.

name: Endurance 90
notes: Fuel if needed according to context.

name: Endurance 2h
notes: Keep intensity controlled.

name: Long endurance
notes: Practise event fuelling.

name: Tempo 2×20
notes: Use individualized power; avoid turning it into threshold failure.

name: Threshold 3×12
notes: Progress duration before power.

name: Threshold 2×20
notes: Classic template; not mandatory.

name: Over-unders
structure: 3×12 min alternating 2 min just below / 1 min just above threshold
notes: Keep average controlled.

name: VO2 4×5
notes: Strong, even pacing; avoid sprint starts.

name: VO2 5×4
notes: Stop before repeated major power collapse.

name: VO2 6×3
notes: Useful when 5-min repeats are too long.

name: 30/15 microintervals
structure: 3×10–13 reps of 30 s hard / 15 s float; 4 min sets
notes: Use power-duration curve, not fixed FTP alone.

name: Neuromuscular sprints
notes: Only when fresh; stop if peak power drops substantially.

name: Sprint interval session
notes: High fatigue; not default for all riders.

name: Long ride + late effort
notes: Use only after base and with adequate fuelling.

name: Cadence skill
structure: 6×1 min fast cadence within easy ride
notes: No bouncing; not a fitness interval.

name: Strength A
notes: Squat/leg press; RDL; split squat; calf; brief trunk.

name: Strength B
notes: Alternative exercise selection; long rests; leave reps in reserve.

name: Strength maintenance
notes: Low volume, high quality.

name: Mobility 10

name: Easy yoga 25
